data.rationale: The proposal gets the same procedure in the right order with matching inputs (two cities, country, month), but it has three problems: it says "Send or discard" where the true workflow says to discard and never send, it hardcodes "ahead" in the offset wording, and it lists derived values (time difference, holiday dates) as inputs when they are actually read from the site, though the steps are otherwise concrete enough to automate.
